entity: Messrs. Brady, Bishop, Dickenson, and Kantor
summary: Messrs. Brady, Bishop, Dickenson, and Kantor, a group of mineral exploration geologists, argued that minerals exploration should be treated as a vitally necessary exception on all public lands open for mineral entry. They opposed the application of ORV regulations to mining and exploration activities. Their position was part of a broader wave of comments from mining interests that ultimately led the Department to exempt mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the ORV regulations.
